description: This line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) as a function of the number of queries used during inference, comparing three different retrieval strategies: DPR without query expansion, DPR with corpus expansion, and DPR with document expansion. The x-axis, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S).”, is linear and spans from 0 to 10, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10”, is also linear and ranges from 33.0 to 36.0. The black line, representing “DPR w/o query”, remains constant at approximately 34.4 throughout the entire range. The red line, representing “DPR w/ corpus expansion”, starts at approximately 35.2, rises to a peak of 35.7 at S=2, and then remains relatively stable at approximately 35.7 until S=10. The green line, representing “DPR w/ document expansion”, starts at approximately 34.9, rises slightly to a peak of approximately 35.0 at S=2, then fluctuates slightly before settling at approximately 34.9 at S=10. The blue line, representing “DPR w/ query expansion”, starts at approximately 34.9, rises to a peak of approximately 35.0 at S=2, then declines steadily to approximately 34.5 at S=10.
